# function: normalize_selector

Trims whitespace from both ends of a selector and replaces each internal run of whitespace with a single space. This is equivalent to replace(trimspace(selector), "/\\s+/", " ").

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

locals {
  selector = provider::ctrlplane::normalize_selector(<<-EOT
    (
      resource.version == 'ctrlplane.dev/kubernetes/cluster/v1' &&
      resource.metadata['kubernetes/status'] == 'running'
    )
  EOT
  )
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
normalize_selector(selector string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `selector` (String) Selector expression to normalize.
